# Owen Ford

## Overview

- **Age:** About thirty or thirty-five years old when arriving in Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v5 c2 P67](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0067), [v5 c2 P68](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0068)</sub>
- **Origin:** Vancouver  <sub>[v4 c34 P30](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0030)</sub>
- **Role:** Novelist and former newspaper man  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023), [v5 c2 P67](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0067)</sub>

## Appearance

Owen is tall and broad-shouldered with thick brown hair, a finely-cut nose and chin, and large, brilliant dark-gray eyes. He has a pleasant voice, a delightful smile, and dresses well.

_Sources: [v4 c23 P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006)_

## Personality

Owen is charming, agreeable, and emotionally sensitive. He connects quickly with like-minded people, easily earning the trust of others and winning over housekeepers like Susan with warm compliments.

_Sources: [v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006), [v4 c24 P7](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0007), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002)_

## Traits

- Charming and friendly  <sub>[v4 c24 P6](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0006), [v4 c24 P7](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0007)</sub>
- Sensitive and passionate  <sub>[v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018)</sub>

## Abilities

- Writing novels and magazine short stories  <sub>[v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023), [v5 c2 P67](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0067)</sub>
- Photography  <sub>[v4 c39 P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005)</sub>

## Goals

- To write a great Canadian novel  <sub>[v4 c23 P18](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0018), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>

## History

Owen Ford traveled to Four Winds to recover from typhoid fever on his doctor's advice and to see his grandparents' old home. While staying in Four Winds, he befriended Anne and Gilbert Blythe and fell deeply in love with Leslie Moore. Recognizing the rich potential in Captain Jim Boyd's life experiences, Owen collaborated with him to write a book based on Captain Jim's life. He temporarily left Four Winds after confessing his feelings for Leslie to Anne, but returned after Leslie was free to court her. Owen and Leslie married, had children, and later set off on a year-long trip to Japan so Owen could gather material for his next novel.

_Sources: [v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P18](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0018), [v4 c24 P7](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0007), [v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006), [v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 c26 P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 c34 P30](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0030), [v4 c36 P27](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0027), [v4 c38 P1](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0001), [v4 c39 P5](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0005), [v5 c2 P67](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0067), [v5 c2 P68](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0068)_

## Background by volume

- Grandson of John Selwyn, the schoolmaster who built the house of dreams  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>
- Worked as a newspaper journalist and published short stories in magazines  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 c23 P23](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0023)</sub>
- Suffered a severe bout of typhoid fever prior to coming to Four Winds  <sub>[v4 c22 P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019)</sub>

## Quotes

> And if inspiration comes from beauty, I should certainly be able to begin my great Canadian novel here.  <sub>[v4 c23 P18](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0018)</sub>

> We’ll collaborate. You will give the soul and I the body. Oh, we’ll write a famous book between us, Captain Jim. And we’ll get right to work.  <sub>[v4 c25 P6](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0006)</sub>

> Mrs. Blythe, I love Leslie. LOVE her! That seems too weak a word!  <sub>[v4 c26 P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002)</sub>
